scenario: DS-source twin of the K vector formal/k/rgate.key_separates: a second key arriving inside the first key's cooldown window fires, because the window belongs to (r, 1) and not to (r, 2) (LCDB.3.3.3). Drives adapter_ds_rate_allow (rete/adapters.c): the lookup for (r, 2) at 5s finds no entry and allows, while an activation of (r, 1) at that instant would be suppressed (cool_suppress). Pins the per-key separation of windows across time; the same-instant case is cool_perkey.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    k: Int key
    n: Int mutable

rule r cooldown 10_s:
    Trig t
->
    log info "fire {t.k}"
